name: zhixing-data-hub
description: 知行数枢企业数据智能运营中枢 Monorepo

scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --directory services/api python scripts/database.py upgrade
scripts.db:status: uv run --directory services/api python scripts/database.py status
scripts.db:seed: uv run --directory services/api python scripts/database.py seed
scripts.db:rebuild:test: uv run --directory services/api python scripts/database.py rebuild --confirm-test-database
scripts.check: node tools/workspace.mjs check && pnpm --filter @zhixing/web check && uv run --directory services/api ruff check src tests scripts && uv run --directory services/api mypy src && uv run --package zhixing-agent-runtime ruff check packages/agent-runtime/src packages/agent-runtime/tests && uv run --package zhixing-agent-runtime mypy packages/agent-runtime/src && uv run --directory services/adapters/codex-runtime ruff check src tests && uv run --directory services/adapters/codex-runtime mypy src && uv run --package zhixing-jobs ruff check packages/jobs/src packages/jobs/tests && uv run --package zhixing-jobs mypy packages/jobs/src && uv run --directory services/worker ruff check src tests scripts && uv run --directory services/worker mypy src && uv run --directory services/mock-commerce ruff check src tests && uv run --directory services/mock-commerce mypy src && uv run --directory services/mock-memory ruff check src tests && uv run --directory services/mock-memory mypy src && uv run --directory services/mock-knowledge ruff check src tests && uv run --directory services/mock-knowledge mypy src && uv run --directory mcp/enterprise-gateway ruff check src tests scripts && uv run --directory mcp/enterprise-gateway mypy src && pnpm test
scripts.check:connectors: uv run --package zhixing-connectors ruff check packages/connectors/src packages/connectors/tests && uv run --package zhixing-connectors mypy packages/connectors/src && uv run --package zhixing-connectors pytest packages/connectors/tests
scripts.test: node --test tests/workspace.test.mjs tests/codex-runner.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @zhixing/web test && pnpm check:connectors && uv run --directory services/api pytest && uv run --package zhixing-agent-runtime pytest packages/agent-runtime/tests && uv run --directory services/adapters/codex-runtime pytest && uv run --package zhixing-jobs pytest packages/jobs/tests && uv run --directory services/worker pytest && uv run --directory services/mock-commerce pytest && uv run --directory services/mock-memory pytest && uv run --directory services/mock-knowledge pytest && uv run --directory mcp/enterprise-gateway pytest
